newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish town hosts air-guitar world championships.
newsitem.headline: Finnish town hosts air-guitar world championships.

text.p: If you can pretend to play a guitar better than anybody else, you could walk away with a real one.
All are invited to the "air-guitar world championships", now in their second year and hosted by the town of Oulu in northern Finland on August 29.

Pretenders to world mastery in the art, which is practised by aspiring rock stars everywhere, may take the stage with or without background music -- but they are not allowed to play a real instrument.
"It's the choreography that makes a good air-guitarist," organiser Pekka Puusti said on Monday. Top prize is a Fender Stratocaster guitar.
